```plato

    // The unsigned angle between a and b, in [0, Pi]. The cosine similarity is
    // clamped to [-1, 1] before Acos so floating-point drift cannot produce a NaN.
    // Preconditions: a and b are non-zero.
    AngleBetween(a: IVector, b: IVector): Angle
        => a.CosineSimilarity(b).Clamp(-1.0, 1.0).Acos;
```
